clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —Requirements for manufacture, dimensions, tolerances and marking for 900 elbows made of injections moulded PVC for water supplies.

clauses.title: The laying length
clauses.text: 2.1 The laying length  and the tolerances there on shall comply with those given in Table 1. * General  requirements SUMMARY OF IS 7834 (PART 3) : 1987 - INJECTION MOULDED PVC SOCKET FITTINGS WITH SOLVENT CEMENT JOINTS FOR WATER SUPPLIES PART-3 SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS FOR 900 ELBOWS First Revision Note— For typical illustration of 90° elbow see Fig.1 of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS :7834 (Part 3) : 1987  Specification for  injection moulded PVC socket fittings with solvent cement joints for water supplies ; Part 3 - for 90° elbows (first revision).
